## Cambodia

```{r Cambodia read data}
Cambodia_Battery_Roster <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Battery Roster.dta")
Cambodia_HHRoster <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/HHRoster.dta")
Cambodia_Main_Dataset <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Main Dataset.dta")

Cambodia_Solar_Roster <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Solar Roster.dta")
Cambodia_Village_Fuel_Roster <- read_dta("Data/Raw/Cambodia/Village_Fuel Roster.dta")
```
